data.name: Uncanny Defense
data.description: When fighting defensively or taking the total defense action, if you attempt a Ref lex saving throw or are the target of a combat maneuver, you can spend a number of stamina points up to your Dexterity bonus to gain a bonus on the Ref lex save or to your CMD equal to the number of stamina points you spent.
